[❗ This game may contain flashing lights and moving images ❗] 
[🛠 We are working on new content! For more info, join our chat server! 🛠] 
[📷 A graphics level of 6-10 is recommended 📷]

Welcome to Checho's Deltarune Roleplay! Roleplay as a vast assortment of characters from DELTARUNE in a fun, expansive world!
Checho's started development in 2018 and has, over time, been worked on by two dozen different Developers and countless contributors. We hope you enjoy!

[DISCLAIMER] 
DELTARUNE was made by Toby Fox and the DELTARUNE team. This is a fan project, and we're not affiliated with anyone who made DELTARUNE.

[MISC] 
New accounts unfortunately have to wait 30 days to join the game. This doesn't apply in VIP servers!
A FaQ can be found in-game in the form of the MANUAL!
Find a bug? Send a modcall with the reason "Bug Report"
